profile_text.body:
Khosla Ventures is a for-profit investor founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California. Its website describes the firm as investing in companies best positioned to harness AI's exponential advances to build beneficial, human-aligned intelligence. The site also mentions a finance workflow platform built with proprietary data and world-class AI talent, and says autonomous driving in closed systems is easy to deploy.

The site highlights Radical Health, which emerged from stealth with $5 million in pre-seed funding led by Khosla Ventures and uses AI to personalize cancer treatment guidance. A statement on the site says AI will do 80% of the economically valuable work humans do today for 80% of all jobs. The site also references 80+ companies building AI, brain interfaces, gene therapy, fusion, robotics, and self-driving.

Khosla Ventures has no products and no cases listed, and 281 California law exposure entries.
